proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: with the pointwise description of quotient sheaves standing, injectivity of U -> U' x U'/R' U/R follows because two sections mapping equal agree after f, and after refining T along a tau-covering an R-equivalence r between them maps to r' in R' with s'(r') = t'(r'), hence r' = e'(f(a)); cartesianity forces r = e(a), so a = b; surjectivity follows by refining T twice so that a lifting pair (a', b) with a relation r' in R' is present, pulling r' back along the cartesian square to r in R, and reading off the section t(r) of U mapping to (a', class of b) (source lines 4156-4185)

core_obligations: Injectivity (proof lines 4160-4177): a, b in U(T) mapping to the same element agree after f; after a tau-covering refinement an R-equivalence r exists (045Y description); f(r) has equal source and target in R', hence equals the identity e'(f(a)) by 0233; cartesianity of the first square forces r = e(a), so a = b.

Surjectivity (proof lines 4179-4185): after refinements, a section (a', class of b) of the fibre product admits r' in R' with a' = t'(r'), s'(r') = f(b); cartesianity lifts r' to r in R with s(r) = b; then t(r) maps to (a', class of b).
proof_roadmap: Prove injectivity via the identity-section argument and cartesianity (proof lines 4160-4177).
Prove surjectivity by lifting the relation along the cartesian square (proof lines 4179-4185).
